units: <cite ref="Eruvin 22a">Erub. 22ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 846:1">Yalk. Deut. 846</cite> <he>להַשְׁלִיכוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="M02816"><he>מַשּׂוֹא</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Sh’mini 11 <he>הבחורים … ומַשְׁלִיכִין חומר וכ׳</he> young men and boys struck him (the drunken man) and cast mud in his face.
<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 1:9">Midr. Prov. ch. I</cite> <he>נַשְׁלִיךְ אותו לבור</he> let us cast him into a pit.
<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 1:11">Ib.</cite> <he>נטל חכה והִשְׁלִיכָהּ לים</he> he took a hook and threw it into the sea.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:2">Lam. R. to II, 1</cite> <he>הִשְׁלִיכוֹ לארץ</he> he cast him off (his shoulder and) to the ground; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be thrown. Tanḥ. Vayesh. 2 כיון שה׳ לבור וכ׳ when he was thrown into the pit, his face changed &c. Tanḥ. Noah 10 ברשותו הוּשְׁלַכְנוּ וכ׳ by his order we have been thrown (into the furnace) &c.; a. e.—Part. מוּשְׁלָךְ; f. מוּשְׁלֶכֶת &c.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:5">Gen. R. s. 8</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 13">Yalk. ib. 13</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00842"><he>בלורין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 43:30">Sifré Deut. 43</cite> <he>נבלת … שהיתה מוש׳ וכ׳</he> the corpse of J.… which lay exposed to heat in day-time and to cold &c. Midr. Prov. l. c. <he>טורח … מוש׳ עליו</he> the care for the household was thrown upon him (Reuben).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20:9">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> <he>ולמה … נִשְׁלַכְתִּי לתוכה וכ׳</he> why did not Moses strike it (the Nile)? He said, I have been thrown into it, and it did not harm me &c.; a. e.
